name: nnmil
label: nnMIL
summary: Full-dimensional pooling with windowed feature sampling.
attentionNote: Each member averages normalized attention across its feature windows.

name: clam_sb
label: CLAM-SB
summary: Gated attention with instance-level clustering of the most and least attended patches.

options.label: Attention dimensions
options.help: Hidden width of the attention network. CLAM's small model uses 256, its big model 384.

options.label: Gated attention
options.help: Multiply the attention scores by a sigmoid gate, as CLAM does by default.

options.label: Attention dropout follows Dropout
options.help: Off, as published: the attention branches drop 25% whenever Dropout is above 0, whatever its value. On, they use the Dropout setting.

options.label: Patches per instance class (B)
options.help: The B most and B least attended patches of each slide train the instance classifiers. A slide with fewer than 2B patches uses half of them.

options.label: Slide loss weight
options.help: Weight of the slide-level loss; the instance-clustering loss gets the rest. 1 turns instance clustering off.

options.label: Instance loss
options.help: Loss of the instance classifiers. CLAM's published runs use the smooth top-1 SVM (margin 1, temperature 1).

options.label: Mutually exclusive subtypes
options.help: Also teach every other class's instance classifier that this slide's most attended patches are negative. CLAM uses this for subtyping tasks.

reference: Lu et al., Nature Biomedical Engineering 2021

name: clam_mb
label: CLAM-MB
summary: One attention branch and slide classifier per class, with instance-level clustering.

options.label: Attention dimensions
options.help: Hidden width of the attention network. CLAM's small model uses 256, its big model 384.

options.label: Gated attention
options.help: Multiply the attention scores by a sigmoid gate, as CLAM does by default.

options.label: Attention dropout follows Dropout
options.help: Off, as published: the attention branches drop 25% whenever Dropout is above 0, whatever its value. On, they use the Dropout setting.

options.label: Patches per instance class (B)
options.help: The B most and B least attended patches of each slide train the instance classifiers. A slide with fewer than 2B patches uses half of them.

options.label: Slide loss weight
options.help: Weight of the slide-level loss; the instance-clustering loss gets the rest. 1 turns instance clustering off.

options.label: Instance loss
options.help: Loss of the instance classifiers. CLAM's published runs use the smooth top-1 SVM (margin 1, temperature 1).

options.label: Mutually exclusive subtypes
options.help: Also teach every other class's instance classifier that this slide's most attended patches are negative. CLAM uses this for subtyping tasks.

attentionNote: Each member's map is the attention branch of its predicted class, as CLAM's heatmaps use.
reference: Lu et al., Nature Biomedical Engineering 2021

name: transmil
label: TransMIL
summary: Nyström Transformer over patch tokens with a class token and pyramid position encoding.

options.label: Transformer layers
options.help: Nyström self-attention layers. The position encoding follows the first layer, as in TransMIL's two-layer model; a one-layer model encodes positions before its layer.

options.label: Attention heads
options.help: Heads per layer. The embedding dimensions must divide evenly by them.

options.label: Nyström landmarks
options.help: Landmark tokens that approximate full self-attention; TransMIL uses half the embedding dimensions.

options.label: Pseudo-inverse iterations
options.help: Moore-Penrose iterations of the Nyström approximation.

options.label: Attention dropout
options.help: Dropout on each attention layer's output.

options.label: Pyramid position encoding (PPEG)
options.help: Depthwise 3×3, 5×5 and 7×7 convolutions over the patch tokens laid out on a square grid in bag order.

options.label: Value residual convolution
options.help: Add a depthwise convolution over the attention values along the sequence (kernel 33), as TransMIL's Nyström layers do.

attentionNote: Each member's map is the class token's softmax attention to the patches in the last layer, computed exactly and averaged over heads; the copies that square the token grid count toward their source patches.

name: dsmil
label: DSMIL
summary: A max-instance classifier plus attention to each class's critical patch.

options.label: Shared input layer
options.help: Project patches with the input layer under Model architecture before the instance classifier, as standardized benchmark libraries do. Off, as published, DSMIL classifies the patch features directly.

options.label: Query dimensions
options.help: Width of the query network that compares patches with the critical patch.

options.label: Nonlinear query network
options.help: Two layers with ReLU and tanh; off, a single linear layer.

options.label: Value projection
options.help: Project patch embeddings before pooling them; off, they are pooled as they are.

options.label: Value dropout
options.help: Dropout before the value projection.

options.label: Max-instance loss weight
options.help: Weight of the max-instance classifier's loss; the slide loss gets the rest. DSMIL weights both equally.

options.label: Average both classifiers
options.help: Predict with the mean of the slide and max-instance classifiers' probabilities; off, the slide classifier alone.

attentionNote: Each member's map is the attention to its predicted class's critical patch.

name: dtfd
label: DTFD-MIL
summary: Attention over random pseudo-bags, distilled into a second attention tier.

options.label: Pseudo-bags per slide
options.help: Random groups each slide's patches are split into: 4 in the authors' code, 5 and 8 in the paper's CAMELYON16 and TCGA lung runs. Testing uses one fixed split per slide size, so predictions are reproducible.

options.label: Test-time pseudo-bag splits
options.help: Random splits whose predicted probabilities are averaged when testing, each from a fixed seed, so predictions repeat. The authors' code uses 1; with MaxMinS one split moved a slide's probability by up to 0.33, so 8 gives steadier clinical predictions.

options.label: Feature distillation
options.help: What each pseudo-bag passes to the second tier.

options.label: Patches distilled per pseudo-bag
options.help: For MaxMinS and MaxS: patches taken from each end of the pseudo-bag's ranking.

options.label: Residual blocks
options.help: Residual blocks after the input layer (the authors' numLayer_Res, 0 by default).

options.label: Attention dimensions
options.help: Hidden width of both tiers' gated attention.

options.label: Classifier dropout
options.help: Dropout before both tiers' classifiers.

attentionNote: Each member's map is the weight of each patch in the slide embedding: its attention within its pseudo-bag times the second tier's attention to that pseudo-bag. With MaxMinS or MaxS distillation only the distilled patches carry weight.

name: acmil
label: ACMIL
summary: Several attention branches with masking of top patches and a diversity penalty.

options.label: Attention branches
options.help: Branches with their own attention and classifier. One branch with no masking is gated ABMIL.

options.label: Top patches eligible for masking
options.help: While fitting, part of each branch's most attended patches is hidden (stochastic top-k instance masking). 0 turns masking off.

options.label: Masked fraction
options.help: Fraction of those top patches hidden at random each step. ACMIL's authors report that 0 is sometimes more stable.

options.label: Attention dimensions
options.help: Hidden width of the gated attention.

options.label: Classifier dropout
options.help: Dropout before the branch and slide classifiers.

attentionNote: Each member's map is the mean of its branches' attention, which is what its slide classifier pools.

name: mean_pool
label: Mean pooling MIL
summary: Mean of patch embeddings with a classifier head.

name: max_pool
label: Max pooling MIL
summary: Element-wise maximum of patch embeddings with a classifier head.

name: slide_linear
label: Slide-embedding linear probe
summary: Linear read-out of one slide encoder embedding per slide.

name: slide_mlp
label: Slide-embedding MLP probe
summary: One hidden layer over a slide encoder embedding.
